scenarios.title: Successful QR or barcode scan in Microsoft Edge with camera permission granted
given: The user opens the registration page using Microsoft Edge on a device with an available webcam
Camera permission has been allowed for the site origin
scenarios.when: The user presents a valid code (e.g. 'REG12345') to the webcam viewfinder
then: The live camera viewfinder displays the video feed
The code is recognized and automatically populates the registration ID field
Registration advances with the scanned ID

scenarios.title: Fallback to manual ID entry when camera permission is denied in Microsoft Edge
given: The user opens the registration page in Microsoft Edge
Camera permission prompt is dismissed or explicitly denied for the site
scenarios.when: The user interacts with the registration page
then: A notification indicating camera access is unavailable or denied is visible to the user
The manual ID entry field remains clearly accessible and editable
The user can type a registration ID (e.g. 'MANUAL987') and submit successfully

scenarios.title: Camera access permission is restricted strictly to the site origin
given: Camera permission has been granted for the registration site origin in Microsoft Edge
scenarios.when: A different origin or third-party context attempts to access the camera on the same browser session
then: Camera permission is not automatically inherited by the other origin
The browser requires a distinct permission prompt or prevents unauthorized camera access for the external origin

scenarios.title: Manual ID entry remains available while camera scanner is actively streaming
given: The user is on the registration page in Microsoft Edge
The webcam viewfinder is actively streaming
scenarios.when: The user types an ID (e.g. 'BACKUP456') directly into the manual entry field and submits
then: The manual entry submission is accepted
The registration continues using the manually entered ID

scenarios.title: Unreadable or invalid barcode presented to the camera scanner
given: The registration page webcam scanner is active in Microsoft Edge
scenarios.when: An unreadable or unrecognized barcode (e.g. 'INVALID000') is shown to the camera
then: A visible scan error or retry message is displayed to the user
The webcam feed remains open to allow another scanning attempt
The manual ID input field remains accessible for manual entry

scenarios.title: Registration page handling when no webcam hardware is available
given: The user accesses the registration page in Microsoft Edge
No webcam hardware is connected or detected on the device
then: A notice is shown stating no camera could be detected
The manual ID entry input is presented as the primary input method for the user
